supported: The mechanism faithfully transported real RWKV-written bytes: all 117 recorded snapshots matched their artifact hash and left the original action output unchanged.
In the eight current same-target chains where the exact snapshot entered the later action prompt, the later RWKV action preserved identical bytes in all eight and changed them in zero.

The JSON model-facing snapshot uses action-protocol-adjacent field names including action_type/content/path. All 29 snapshot-exposed terminal action-materialization failures returned top-level action or action_type shapes and none reached normalization.

The protocol failure increase occurs after snapshot exposure and before action execution, then reduces later attempts, tasks, witness stages, and proof opportunities. This is the observed amplification path.
not_proven_before_scoring: Whether any preserved bytes are externally correct.
Whether the snapshot variable improves External, Strict, Completed, FP, or FN.
A randomized paired causal effect size: Round21 and Round22 are separate stochastic runs, so the 15.10% versus 2.07% association can include task difficulty and prompt-position confounding.
